answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 216 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is recorded against the terrace challenge, the vertex audit can replay the velvet history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 1097 identities would post 2197 proofs and burn roughly 45 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
